lines.en: label sportswars13:
scene fivelegs1
: Aaaaaaand back to reality!
: How confident are you in that statement? Because it appears to me that you are still very much detached.

: Yeah, I’m kind of hanging on by a thread right now. But hey, at least there haven’t been any casualties so far. And that’s saying a lot since today has been extremely dangerous in many different ways.
: Right. But at what point are you going to be explaining why you’re holding a pair of arms?
scene fivelegs2
: It’s not a true pair. They’re both right arms.
: Oh, okay. That explains everything.
: See? This is why we’re friends. Always on the same wavelength.
: I’m very worried about you.
scene fivelegs3
: Me too! But that doesn’t matter because the time has come for our final outdoor competition! And with the second floor only one point away from tying this thing, the stakes have never been higher!
: The stakes have been higher on many occasions, actually.
: In fact, even if we win right now, the second floor could still win the competition-
: Shut it, Makoto! I’m just trying to get everybody hyped up!
: Is hyping us up even necessary after the game we just witnessed?
: Yeah. I think it’s all downhill from here, Imani. Death ball is going to be hard to top even if the entire thing already seems like a blur.
: You’d think it would be hard to top! But you’ve yet to experience the next Imani-original competition — the five-legged race!
: Let me guess — you ordered legs as well?
: These arms are going to be legs today.
scene fivelegs4
: What?
: My black market guy is on vacation this month. These were all I could get on such short notice. So, for the sake of everyone involved in today’s contest, we’re going to have to use our imagination.
: To do what, though? Surely you don’t intend to just...repeat the relay race while making the girls carry an arm, do you?
: Not at all. The rules are actually really simple this time.
scene fivelegs5
: And they revolve almost entirely around these two strange mannequins I picked up from Goodwill!
: I honestly can’t tell if Imani’s contests are way worse or way better than the ones we normally come up with.
: I miss the date war.
: Same.

: I, for one, am grateful for these new contests. The unique spin Miss Imai is placing on all of these classic games I’d only read about before is making them out to be far more interesting than I expected.
: Now, if I could just recommend a horseback riding competition so I might actually win something for once-
: Sure, Touka! Ask for horseback riding! We all know what ya really mean by that!
: Can y’all shut your mouths so I can explain this thing already?!
: To any girls participating, make your way to the center circle now!
scene black
scene fivelegs6
: It appears we meet again, Zagull Throat Spear...Lidearel Lightfoot. I see you’ve come prepared for failure this time.
: I just...don’t want to get hit in the head again...
: We’re not the only team that’s made changes, Molly. It appears that you’ve abandoned your former partner completely.
: A stag beetle crawled up my leg and informed me that I must take place in this competition or that my heart will be torn from my chest by the shadow of contempt.
scene fivelegs7
: Well, it’s good to see you two are on the same page already.
: The Priestess of Fallen Snow and I have raised our prayer to max level and are prepared to resurrect our mannequin’s corpse without any reagents whatsoever!
: Do anyone else’s ears tingle?
: Mine kind of do, but...I think it’s just the helmet...
scene fivelegs8
: Like I was saying, the rules of this contest are simple! Each team will take an arm, avoid Catherine, and then replace your mannequin’s missing leg!
: With...with the arm?
: Well, there ain’t any legs, Ayane! Have you guys been paying any attention at all?!
: Miss Imai...can I ask a question?...
: No.
: But...Catherine-
: You’ll cross that bridge when you come to it.
: What a strange and curious day it’s been so far.
: Probably the strangest one I’ve had...maybe ever, now that I think about it.
: Not me. I am what’s called an “exhibitionist” now.
scene fivelegs9
: What is that, exactly? Some sort of...artist? No. Athlete perhaps?
: I believe it is the term for people who perform lewd acts in public.
scene fivelegs10
: Lewd...acts?
: I said what I meant and I meant what I said. But this does not change who I am. I am still the Tsuneyo Tojo you are somewhat familiar with.
: I don’t believe myself to be familiar with you at all, Tsuneyo. Especially if this...exhibitionist thing is not just a bit you’ve created to toy with my heart.
: There is no need, for you are but one of two members on our floor who have yet to acknowledge your attraction to me. Your heart can not be tampered with unless I kill something you love.
: You can have my sister. Just spare my Misaki.
scene fivelegs11
: Your sister?...
: I have never cooked with human meat before. I eagerly anticipate this challenge.
: And I eagerly anticipate the end of this competition so that I may reset and try again for a normal day tomorrow.
scene fivelegs12
: This...feels a lot more real than I expected it to.
: Because it is real, Ayane. You think I’d half ass this competition after Touka handed me her credit card? Hell nah. Only the best for my girls.
: The fact that...they’re both right arms...implies that more than one person died for this competition...doesn’t it?
: Or that the person who died for this competition was born with more than one right arm, which would make this investigation way more interesting.
: So we just...put the leg-
: Arm.
scene fivelegs13
: So we just...put the arm into the...mannequin’s...leg hole?
: And avoid Catherine.
: Do you-
: Nope.
: Oh, okay...
scene fivelegs14
: I have a real problem with the fact that my first intentions with this disembodied limb are to do inappropriate things with it. Perhaps I’m even more of a pervert than I formerly believed?
: I do not know if I am permitted to handle lifeless limbs in spring. The tenets of this season have not yet been fully established in His great book yet.
scene fivelegs15
: Can’t you just ask? I thought your divine powers allowed you to communicate with your patron at any given moment?
: Communication has been severed. It’s like my ears have been stuffed with special filters that keep His message out. I can’t help but worry that something may have happened in my absence.
: Meh. If there’s anything I understand about gods, it’s that they always come back in some form. So even if He Who Drinks the Light is currently missing, I’m sure he’ll turn up soon enough.
scene fivelegs16
: I hope you are correct.
: I would not be able to survive in the dark.
scene noonsky
: Okay! Are there any final questions before we kick off our final real-ish sports day contest?!
: Um-
: Any questions not about Catherine!
: Imani! Wanna go out some time?
: Only if I can surrender you to the local dog pound for being such a BITCH! Ayooooo!
: I hope you’re happy, Imani. You’ve just earned yourself a detention on Monday as well.
: What?! I can’t get detention! I have tenure!
: You’ve only been here for-
: Miku, close your ears!
: Wha- oh! Okay! Done!
: Go, go, go, go, go!
scene fivelegs17
scene fivelegs18
: D...Dragon!!!!!!
: That’s no dragon! That’s Catherine!...........Probably!
: Catherine’s an alligator?!
: Imani’s been tryin’ to kill us with those all heckin’ day! Y’all are just the next group who has to deal with it!
: Correction! Catherine is a crocodile. And the only thing she hates more than being called an alligator is when people wave meat in front of her.
: Do you think she’s friendly?
: She appears to be part of the bronze dragonflight at first glance, so she likely holds some sort of dominion over time! Remain vigilant or time may be reset at any moment!
: You’re right, but not in the way you think you are!
: What even makes an alligator different from a crocodile in the first place?!
scene fivelegs17
: A few things! But the easiest way to tell them apart is by their snout. Catherine here has a V-shaped snout, which means she’s a crocodile because V stands for vcrocodile.
: But if she had a u-shaped snout, she’d be an alligator because-
: Because U stands for ualligator?
: No, U stands for “You suck!” Take that, nerd!
scene fivelegs19
: Why am I being made fun of?! I’m the only one who’s competed in three contests today! I should be praised for how hard-working and durable I am!
: Girl, there ain’t no time for praise! You’ve got a hungry friggin’ crocodile trying to steal your fifth arm! Defend yourselves!
: I do wish Miss Imai would have informed me she was going to use my card to purchase live animals so I could have scheduled medical exams for all of them. This is getting out of hand.
: Don’t you mean “out of arm?”
scene fivelegs20
: No. I mean-
scene fivelegs21
: Oh! “Out of hand!” I made a pun!
: I’m actually quite funny, aren’t I?
: Did you hear about the crocodile and the rooster who created a child together?
scene fivelegs22
: Is such a thing even possible?
: It was a croc-a-doodle-doo.
: A what?
: Croc-a-doodle-doo.
: Because the noise a rooster makes is “cock-a-doodle-doo.” And if you grab the cock and move it out of the way-
: Please don’t say it like that.
: If you bend the cock to the side-
: Tsuneyo, stop it.
: Please just allow me to handle the cock the way I want to handle it or the joke will not make sense.
scene fivelegs23
: Hah...you’d think I’d be able to discern by now whether or not people are being sincere with me. But with you, I feel like I understand that even less than I do with Sensei.
: I am a mysterious, noodle-filled, cock-handling exhibitionist. You should not blame yourself for being unable to keep up with my quick-witted genius.
: You and Yasu both. She’s a genius of sorts too — just in a way that none of us can come close to grasping.
: In what way would you consider her a genius?
scene fivelegs24
: Well, you know that religion she’s always preaching about?
: Yes, I am familiar with her only character trait.

: She has more! You just don’t understand them yet! But, what I was trying to say is that, I looked into some of what she preaches with my mother recently and, as it turns out, she isn’t making any of this up.
: It appears that Yasu’s beliefs are either derivative of or an exact replication of a religion that used to be practiced in Kumon-mi long before any of us were born.
: So long, in fact, that if it were not for my family’s library, I doubt we’d have uncovered any information at all.
: It’s been nearly two-hundred years since it’s shown up in text. But the few text accounts we were able to scrounge up mirror what she says almost one-to-one.
: Which not only makes Yasu the apparent sole authority on this system of beliefs, but-
: Suspicious.
: I was thinking more along the lines of “a genius regarding all things surrounding it,” but yes. I suppose her knowledge is suspicious in a sense as well.
: Can one even be a genius when it comes to a subject that can not be scientifically proven?
: Maybe not. I’m not quite sure, exactly.
: But actually being a genius is far less important than convincing people you are one. And, in many ways, I don’t think we give Yasu enough credit.
: She’s very rarely wrong about...well, anything.
: Perhaps we are all geniuses in our own respect.
: The hole is too small! I can’t get it in!
: Well...maybe not all of us.
: Push...harder!
: I’m...pushing as hard as I can! It’s too tight!
: I can’t last much longer! Hurry, Molly!
: Bear with the pain, Yasu! Just think about the release at the end!
scene fivelegs25
: Um...is it just me, or...
: Definitely not you. It’s been nonstop euphemisms ever since we defeated Catherine.
: It’s making it...kind of hard to focus, but...
scene fivelegs26
: Not as hard as the fact that...I think our mannequin might be alive?...
: I’m pretty sure I saw him breathing a second ago. Just bear with it a little longer, Sana.
: He’s...stroking my hair...
: I’d stroke your hair too if I was a one-legged cyclops.
scene fivelegs27
: You’ve...said many strange things to me over the years, but...I think that one-
: Silence, Sana! And stay still or I’ll never be able to get it in!
: Please don’t do this as well.
: God, it’s so tight!
scene fivelegs28
: There’s no way you aren’t doing this on purpose!
: Almost there, Yasu! I’ve...just about got it!
: Steady! Hold! Hold!
scene fivelegs29
: Nnnngh!!!
: Oi! We’ll be able to heal in just a minute! Just keep holding this thing up or it’ll collapse onto both of us, Priestess!
: So do I! But that happens any time I do strenuous activities and I can assure you it’s only a matter of-
scene fivelegs30
: NGHHH! SOMETHING’S...COMING!
: DAMN IT, AYANE! CAN YOU HURRY UP?!
: Uhh...OOC, are you okay? Do we need to-
scene fivelegs31
: Spiderwebs. A calendar. The ones you keep inside.
: A god. A bucket. Heresy. A man who almost died.
: A ghost. A moon. She’s lying. There’s nowhere we can hide.
: We’re done. We’re doomed. We’re dying. The well has nearly dried.
LINE BREAK
scene noonsky
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
scene fivelegs32
: Yasu?! What’s wrong?!
: Head!...Hurts!...
: Wakana, do you have a key to the nurse’s office?!
: It’s in my office, but I can’t run-
: I’ll go get it and unlock the door!
: I...I didn’t mean to-
: It’s not your fault, Molly. It’s likely just unfortunate timing.
: Yasu, what is it? Another “message?”
: I am permanent...I am perfect! I am permanent...and perfect!
scene fivelegs33
: Tsuneyo! Can you- where did Tsuneyo go? She was here just a second ago.
: It looked like she ran back inside just now. What’s going on with Yasu? I just got back from the taco stand and-
scene fivelegs32
: A bad migraine, most likely. But I need someone to help me carry her to the-
: I’ll help!
: I can help too!
: Just Ayane will be fine. But thank you, Molly.
: Yasu, we’re going to lift you up now. Okay? We’ll get you to a bed to rest.
: I am...permanent! I...am permanent!
: No one is permanent, but we can save our next one-sided philosophical debate for when you are not shaking in the dirt.
scene black
: Ayane, I’ll take her legs. If you could just grab beneath her arms-
: On it. Let’s go, Yasu. Imani should have the door unlocked in a minute.
: Have...to warn...him! Have...to save...
: The lamb!
